findings.text: the new figure script has no trailing newline (ruff W292, confirmed with an independent ruff check restricted to this file); trivial and autofixable, but it is a finding this node's own commit introduced rather than one it inherited.

the pending-work row keeps the pre-existing conditional pattern ("if slug in live_runs: row[\"in_flight\"] = ...") for both in_flight and interrupted, so a plan with no live runs omits both keys from its pending row, while the sprint row (added by this commit) always carries both keys with an empty list. The two surfaces disagree on omitted-vs-empty for the same fact; not a regression (the pending row's in_flight behaved this way before this change) and not exercised by a failing test, but the empty-list-not-missing-key guarantee the commit message and docstring describe only holds for the sprint row.

justifications.durability: tests/test_roadmap_names_interrupted_runs.py drives real pointers through the shared classify_pointer rather than a parallel judgement, so a future change that folds interrupted back into in_flight fails the gate: independently reproduced by disabling the interrupted arm of partition_live_runs in a scratch copy of the reviewed head (23af0cf5) and getting 4 failed / 4 passed, the same four separation tests the worker's declared negative control names, with the log's first line repeating the mutation verbatim. The empty-list-vs-missing-key guarantee on the sprint row is pinned by test_a_sprint_with_no_interrupted_runs_reports_an_empty_list and test_a_plan_with_no_live_runs_reports_empty_lists_not_missing_keys.
justifications.evidence: independently reran the focused gate at the reviewed head and got 8 passed in 0.93s (tests/test_roadmap_names_interrupted_runs.py, venv-direct invocation), matching the manifest's after_suite single-file figure; independently reproduced the negative control in a scratch git-archive copy of 23af0cf5 with the interrupted arm of partition_live_runs disabled and got 4 failed / 4 passed, matching the recorded negative-control-roadmap.log verbatim (same four failing test ids); the manifest's baseline_suite (79 passed at 75b39d4d) and after_suite (87 passed at 23af0cf5, a +8 delta entirely inside the new test file) are consistent with the recorded baseline-suite.log and after-suite.log on disk.
justifications.fit: the mechanism reuses classify_pointer and INTERRUPTED_RUN_PHASE from reckon/crew/recovery.py and reckon/crew/node.py rather than inventing a second judgement, so the roadmap, the sprint view and recover read one classification; the derived lists are still produced in Python and only rendered by any consumer, holding the SPA-renders-not-derives invariant. Docked for the pending-row/sprint-row asymmetry noted in findings and for one new W292 lint finding in the figure script.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/mcp_views.py:1074 adds partition_live_runs, splitting one fleet read into in_flight_by_plan (unchanged call sites, same return shape) and the new interrupted_by_plan, each interrupted row carrying reason and next_action from the classifier's detail/next_action fields; reckon/roadmap.py:1251 calls the partition once and puts both lists on the pending row (:1815-1818) and on the sprint row (:1992-2004), and sprint_state_view (:865-880) always carries both keys per sprint. Each fact in the done-when is pinned by a corresponding new test, and an independent rerun of the full new test file confirms all eight pass at the reviewed head.
justifications.scope_discipline: the four commits (d4085104, 13f789cb, 22aaffd6, 23af0cf5) touch exactly the nine files under the declared orientation_write_paths (git diff --name-only 75b39d4d..23af0cf5), the reviewed worktree is clean at its head, all four commit messages carry a body with no AI attribution and no plan/ticket identifiers, and a base-vs-head ruff delta on the two touched source files is 6 findings on both sides (no new findings in reckon/mcp_views.py or reckon/roadmap.py). The one new finding in the new figure script (W292, no trailing newline) is this node's own, per the file-scoped findings above.
